verses.verse:
त्रयो भेदास्तु वंशीनाम् मुख्यतः परिचीयते।
जिह्वाती च कृष्णा ष तृतीया प्राकृती भवेत्।३७।
verses.text: Three kinds of flute are chiefly recognised: the Jihvāvatī and the Kṛṣṇā, and the third is the Prākṛtī.

commentary.text: That is, by [the kind of] mukharandhra (mouth-hole) the flute is of three main kinds. Their names in order are: (1) Jihvāvatī (fipple flute) (2) Kṛṣṇā (transverse flute) (3) Prākṛtī. Now the merits and faults of each of these, one by one, are considered.

terms.en: Jihvāvatī — flute with a fipple (duct flute)
Prākṛtī — another name for the Tripurā
